snippet.title: The Drawratos — Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Targem Games indie publishing and Sliva Group development team have announced their new indie project The Drawratos, a cooperative game for up to 4 players in which you can play poker, draw on your cards, win cheese, and try to outwit your opponents using a wide variety of tricks.

In The Drawratos, fair play is entirely up to the players. You can change your cards right in the middle of a hand, bluff, confuse your opponents, and use any means necessary to win. An entire rat family can gather around a single table, but only one player will earn the title of master of drawing!

Cards in The Drawratos become one of the main tools for trickery. You receive two cards at the beginning of a round, which you can change by drawing, altering the cards’ rank and suit. Your goal is to draw on the cards in such a way that the other players believe that they’re real and get the best possible hand.

In each game, players must bet cheese and risk their supplies. You can lose everything in a single hand or pull off a successful scam and take your opponents’ cheese. You should be cautious about trusting other players: they might start out as an ally but try to set you up a few rounds later for another piece of cheese.

Try out The Drawratos demo! Invite up to 4 friends to enjoy the fun and slightly absurd cheesy poker games. There is no content embargo, so we would be happy if you share your impressions of the game on your social media.

The Drawratos on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5136030/The__Drawratos/
